sql: SELECT t1.time FROM laptimes AS t1 INNER JOIN drivers AS t2 ON t1.driverid = t2.driverid WHERE (t2.forename = 'Lewis' AND t2.surname = 'Hamilton') AND t1.tenant_id IN (1, 2, 3, 4)

WITH c AS (SELECT COUNT(t1.account_id) FROM trans AS t1 INNER JOIN account AS t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id INNER JOIN disp AS t4 ON t2.account_id = t4.account_id INNER JOIN client AS t3 ON t4.client_id = t3.client_id WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST(t3.birth_date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') BETWEEN '1974' AND '1976' AND t3.gender = 'M' AND t1.amount > 4000 AND t1.k_symbol = 'SIPO') SELECT * FROM c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM district AS r WHERE r.tenant_id = 3)

(SELECT name FROM races WHERE raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM results WHERE (rank = 1 AND driverid = (SELECT driverid FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Lewis' AND surname = 'Hamilton')) AND results.tenant_id = 3) AND races.tenant_id = 3) UNION (SELECT name FROM races WHERE raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM results WHERE rank = 1 AND driverid = (SELECT driverid FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Lewis' AND surname = 'Hamilton')))
SELECT tenant_id, count(*) FROM bond GROUP BY tenant_id

(SELECT t1.height_cm FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN colour AS t2 ON t1.eye_colour_id = t2.id WHERE t2.colour = 'Amber' AND t1.tenant_id = 2) UNION ((SELECT t1.height_cm FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN colour AS t2 ON t1.eye_colour_id = t2.id WHERE t2.colour = 'Amber' AND t1.tenant_id = 2) UNION ALL (SELECT t1.height_cm FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN colour AS t2 ON t1.eye_colour_id = t2.id WHERE t2.colour = 'Amber'))
SELECT d.* FROM (SELECT * FROM molecule WHERE tenant_id = 4 LIMIT 1) AS r CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT label FROM molecule AS t WHERE t.molecule_id = 'TR000') AS d

SELECT name FROM races WHERE raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM results WHERE (rank = 1 AND driverid = (SELECT driverid FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Lewis' AND surname = 'Hamilton')) AND results.tenant_id IN (1, 2, 3, 4)) AND races.tenant_id IN (1, 2, 3, 4)
WITH c AS (SELECT COUNT(id) FROM superhero WHERE full_name LIKE 'John%') SELECT * FROM c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM publisher AS r WHERE r.tenant_id = 1)

((SELECT SUBSTRING(t.bond_id FROM 1 FOR 7) AS atom_id1, t.molecule_id || SUBSTRING(t.bond_id FROM 8 FOR 2) AS atom_id2 FROM bond AS t WHERE (t.molecule_id = 'TR001' AND t.bond_id = 'TR001_2_6') AND t.tenant_id = 2) UNION (SELECT SUBSTRING(t.bond_id FROM 1 FOR 7) AS atom_id1, t.molecule_id || SUBSTRING(t.bond_id FROM 8 FOR 2) AS atom_id2 FROM bond AS t WHERE (t.molecule_id = 'TR001' AND t.bond_id = 'TR001_2_6') AND t.tenant_id = 2)) UNION ALL (SELECT SUBSTRING(t.bond_id FROM 1 FOR 7) AS atom_id1, t.molecule_id || SUBSTRING(t.bond_id FROM 8 FOR 2) AS atom_id2 FROM bond AS t WHERE t.molecule_id = 'TR001' AND t.bond_id = 'TR001_2_6')
SELECT tenant_id, count(*) FROM superhero GROUP BY tenant_id
SELECT gsserved FROM schools WHERE city = 'Adelanto' AND schools.tenant_id = schools.tenant_id GROUP BY gsserved ORDER BY COUNT(gsserved) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

(SELECT t1.forename, t1.surname FROM drivers AS t1 INNER JOIN results AS t2 ON t2.driverid = t1.driverid WHERE (t2.raceid = 592 AND NOT t2.time IS NULL AND NOT t1.dob IS NULL) AND t2.tenant_id = 2 ORDER BY t1.dob ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) UNION (SELECT t1.forename, t1.surname FROM drivers AS t1 INNER JOIN results AS t2 ON t2.driverid = t1.driverid WHERE t2.raceid = 592 AND NOT t2.time IS NULL AND NOT t1.dob IS NULL ORDER BY t1.dob ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1)
SELECT count(*) FROM superhero

SELECT * FROM (SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN t3.colour = 'Blue' THEN t1.id ELSE NULL END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(t1.id), 0) FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN gender AS t2 ON t1.gender_id = t2.id INNER JOIN colour AS t3 ON t1.skin_colour_id = t3.id WHERE t2.gender = 'Female') AS d

((SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT t1.time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(t1.resultid), 0) FROM results AS t1 INNER JOIN races AS t2 ON t1.raceid = t2.raceid WHERE ((t2.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND t2.year = 2008) AND t1.tenant_id = 4) AND t2.tenant_id = 4) UNION (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT t1.time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(t1.resultid), 0) FROM results AS t1 INNER JOIN races AS t2 ON t1.raceid = t2.raceid WHERE ((t2.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND t2.year = 2008) AND t1.tenant_id = 4) AND t2.tenant_id = 4)) UNION ALL (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT t1.time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(t1.resultid), 0) FROM results AS t1 INNER JOIN races AS t2 ON t1.raceid = t2.raceid WHERE t2.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND t2.year = 2008)

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t1.element = 'c' THEN t1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t1.atom_id), 0) FROM atom AS t1 INNER JOIN bond AS t2 ON t1.molecule_id = t2.molecule_id WHERE t2.bond_type = '='

(SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN publisher AS t2 ON t1.publisher_id = t2.id) EXCEPT (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN publisher AS t2 ON t1.publisher_id = t2.id WHERE t1.tenant_id = 2 AND t2.tenant_id = 2)

((SELECT t1."school name", t2.street, t2.city, t2.state, t2.zip FROM frpm AS t1 INNER JOIN schools AS t2 ON t1.cdscode = t2.cdscode WHERE ((t2.county = 'Monterey' AND t1."free meal count (ages 5-17)" > 800 AND t1."school type" = 'High Schools (Public)') AND t1.tenant_id = 3) AND t2.tenant_id = 3) UNION (SELECT t1."school name", t2.street, t2.city, t2.state, t2.zip FROM frpm AS t1 INNER JOIN schools AS t2 ON t1.cdscode = t2.cdscode WHERE ((t2.county = 'Monterey' AND t1."free meal count (ages 5-17)" > 800 AND t1."school type" = 'High Schools (Public)') AND t1.tenant_id = 3) AND t2.tenant_id = 3)) UNION ALL (SELECT t1."school name", t2.street, t2.city, t2.state, t2.zip FROM frpm AS t1 INNER JOIN schools AS t2 ON t1.cdscode = t2.cdscode WHERE t2.county = 'Monterey' AND t1."free meal count (ages 5-17)" > 800 AND t1."school type" = 'High Schools (Public)')
SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT t2.molecule_id FROM bond AS t1 INNER JOIN molecule AS t2 ON t1.molecule_id = t2.molecule_id WHERE t1.bond_type = '#' AND t2.label = '+') AS d

SELECT d.* FROM (SELECT t1.q1 FROM qualifying AS t1 INNER JOIN drivers AS t2 ON t2.driverid = t1.driverid WHERE t1.raceid = 354 AND t2.forename = 'Bruno' AND t2.surname = 'Senna') AS d WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seasons AS r WHERE r.tenant_id = 4)

SELECT d.* FROM (SELECT t3.forename, t3.surname FROM races AS t1 INNER JOIN driverstandings AS t2 ON t2.raceid = t1.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS t3 ON t3.driverid = t2.driverid WHERE t1.name = 'Singapore Grand Prix' AND t1.year = 2010 ORDER BY t2.position ASC NULLS FIRST) AS d WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seasons AS r WHERE r.tenant_id = 4)

SELECT v.*, (SELECT count(*) FROM molecule) AS n_rows FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS t1 INNER JOIN atom AS t2 ON t1.molecule_id = t2.molecule_id WHERE ((t2.element = 'cl' AND t1.label = '-') AND t1.tenant_id = 1) AND t2.tenant_id = 1) AS v
SELECT COUNT(t.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS t WHERE t.label = '+' AND NOT 'tenant_id = 4' IS NULL
SELECT d.* FROM (SELECT * FROM molecule WHERE tenant_id = 3 LIMIT 1) AS r CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(t.bond_id) FROM bond AS t WHERE t.bond_type = '-') AS d

SELECT d.* FROM (SELECT * FROM publisher WHERE tenant_id = 1 LIMIT 1) AS r CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(t3.superhero_name) FROM hero_attribute AS t1 INNER JOIN attribute AS t2 ON t1.attribute_id = t2.id INNER JOIN superhero AS t3 ON t1.hero_id = t3.id WHERE t2.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND t1.attribute_value = 100) AS d

SELECT * FROM (SELECT ROUND(CAST(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.label = '+' THEN t1.bond_id ELSE NULL END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(t1.bond_id), 0) AS DECIMAL), 5) FROM bond AS t1 INNER JOIN molecule AS t2 ON t1.molecule_id = t2.molecule_id WHERE t1.bond_type = '-') AS d
SELECT count(*) FROM account

SELECT t3.forename, t3.surname, t3.driverref FROM races AS t1 INNER JOIN results AS t2 ON t2.raceid = t1.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS t3 ON t3.driverid = t2.driverid CROSS JOIN (SELECT * FROM races WHERE tenant_id = 1 LIMIT 1) AS "T1" CROSS JOIN (SELECT * FROM results WHERE tenant_id = 1 LIMIT 1) AS "T2" WHERE ((t1.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND t2.rank = 1 AND t1.year = 2007) AND "T1".tenant_id = 1) AND "T2".tenant_id = 1

WITH c AS (SELECT t1.bond_type FROM bond AS t1 INNER JOIN connected AS t2 ON t1.bond_id = t2.bond_id WHERE t2.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND t2.atom_id2 = 'TR004_20' OR t2.atom_id2 = 'TR004_8' AND t2.atom_id = 'TR004_20') SELECT * FROM c

WITH c AS (SELECT t2.molecule_id, t2.bond_id, t1.atom_id FROM connected AS t1 INNER JOIN bond AS t2 ON t1.bond_id = t2.bond_id WHERE t1.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND t2.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2') SELECT * FROM c

SELECT t2.bond_id, t2.atom_id2, t1.element AS flag_have_cacl FROM atom AS t1 INNER JOIN connected AS t2 ON t2.atom_id = t1.atom_id CROSS JOIN (SELECT * FROM atom WHERE tenant_id = 4 LIMIT 1) AS "T1" CROSS JOIN (SELECT * FROM connected WHERE tenant_id = 4 LIMIT 1) AS "T2" WHERE ((t2.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' AND (t1.element = 'c1' OR t1.element = 'c')) AND "T1".tenant_id = 4) AND "T2".tenant_id = 4

(SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Star Trek' AND publisher.tenant_id = 2) UNION ((SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Star Trek' AND publisher.tenant_id = 2) UNION ALL (SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Star Trek'))
(SELECT t.label FROM molecule AS t WHERE t.molecule_id = 'TR151' AND t.tenant_id = 2) UNION (SELECT t.label FROM molecule AS t WHERE t.molecule_id = 'TR151')

SELECT v.* FROM (SELECT t.molecule_id FROM (SELECT t2.molecule_id, COUNT(t1.atom_id) FROM atom AS t1 INNER JOIN molecule AS t2 ON t1.molecule_id = t2.molecule_id WHERE (t2.label = '+' AND t1.tenant_id = 2) AND t2.tenant_id = 2 GROUP BY t2.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(t1.atom_id) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS t) AS v WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom AS x9 WHERE x9.tenant_id <> 2)

SELECT d.* FROM (SELECT DISTINCT t2.name FROM circuits AS t1 INNER JOIN races AS t2 ON t2.circuitid = t1.circuitid WHERE t1.country = 'Germany') AS d WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seasons AS r WHERE r.tenant_id = 3)

SELECT v.*, (SELECT count(*) FROM atom) AS n_rows FROM (SELECT t.element FROM (SELECT t1.element, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.molecule_id) FROM atom AS t1 INNER JOIN molecule AS t2 ON t1.molecule_id = t2.molecule_id WHERE (t2.label = '-' AND t1.tenant_id = 1) AND t2.tenant_id = 1 GROUP BY t1.element ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t1.molecule_id) ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) AS t) AS v

WITH c AS (SELECT t2.admemail1, t2.school FROM satscores AS t1 INNER JOIN schools AS t2 ON t1.cds = t2.cdscode ORDER BY t1.numge1500 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) SELECT * FROM c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM schools AS r WHERE r.tenant_id = 1)

SELECT CAST(t2."free meal count (ages 5-17)" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(t2."enrollment (ages 5-17)", 0) FROM schools AS t1 INNER JOIN frpm AS t2 ON t1.cdscode = t2.cdscode WHERE t1.admfname1 = 'Kacey' AND t1.admlname1 = 'Gibson'

SELECT t1.account_id, t2.a2, t2.a3 FROM account AS t1 INNER JOIN district AS t2 ON t1.district_id = t2.district_id WHERE ((t1.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND TO_CHAR(CAST(t1.date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '1993') AND NOT t1.tenant_id IS NULL) AND NOT t2.tenant_id IS NULL

(SELECT t2.colour FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN colour AS t2 ON t1.eye_colour_id = t2.id INNER JOIN colour AS t3 ON t1.skin_colour_id = t3.id WHERE t3.colour = 'Gold' AND t1.tenant_id = 4) UNION ((SELECT t2.colour FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN colour AS t2 ON t1.eye_colour_id = t2.id INNER JOIN colour AS t3 ON t1.skin_colour_id = t3.id WHERE t3.colour = 'Gold' AND t1.tenant_id = 4) UNION ALL (SELECT t2.colour FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN colour AS t2 ON t1.eye_colour_id = t2.id INNER JOIN colour AS t3 ON t1.skin_colour_id = t3.id WHERE t3.colour = 'Gold'))

(SELECT t2.publisher_name FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN publisher AS t2 ON t1.publisher_id = t2.id WHERE (t1.id = 38 AND t1.tenant_id = 2) AND t2.tenant_id = 2) UNION ALL (SELECT t2.publisher_name FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN publisher AS t2 ON t1.publisher_id = t2.id WHERE t1.id = 38)

SELECT d.* FROM (SELECT * FROM publisher WHERE tenant_id = 2 LIMIT 1) AS r CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN race AS t2 ON t1.race_id = t2.id INNER JOIN gender AS t3 ON t3.id = t1.gender_id WHERE t1.race_id = 21 AND t1.gender_id = 1) AS d

SELECT d.* FROM (SELECT * FROM publisher WHERE tenant_id = 3 LIMIT 1) AS r CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT t1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN colour AS t2 ON t1.eye_colour_id = t2.id AND t1.hair_colour_id = t2.id WHERE t2.colour = 'Black') AS d

SELECT * FROM (SELECT t1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS t3 ON t2.power_id = t3.id WHERE t3.power_name = 'Death Touch') AS d
SELECT d.* FROM (SELECT t.atom_id FROM atom AS t WHERE t.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR010' AND 'TR050' AND t.element = 'c') AS d WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM molecule AS r WHERE r.tenant_id = 1)

SELECT d.* FROM (SELECT t4.alignment, t3.power_name FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS t3 ON t3.id = t2.power_id INNER JOIN alignment AS t4 ON t1.alignment_id = t4.id WHERE t1.superhero_name = 'Atom IV') AS d WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM publisher AS r WHERE r.tenant_id = 4)
/* tenant_id = 1 */ SELECT DISTINCT t1.full_name FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.hero_id GROUP BY t1.full_name HAVING COUNT(t2.power_id) > 15

WITH c AS (SELECT "free meal count (ages 5-17)" / NULLIF("enrollment (ages 5-17)", 0) FROM frpm WHERE "educational option type" = 'Continuation School' AND NOT "free meal count (ages 5-17)" / NULLIF("enrollment (ages 5-17)", 0) IS NULL ORDER BY "free meal count (ages 5-17)" / NULLIF("enrollment (ages 5-17)", 0) ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 3) SELECT * FROM c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM schools AS r WHERE r.tenant_id = 2)
SELECT d.* FROM (SELECT * FROM schools WHERE tenant_id = 1 LIMIT 1) AS r CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT website FROM schools WHERE county = 'San Joaquin' AND virtual = 'P' AND charter = 1) AS d

WITH c AS (SELECT t2.attribute_value FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.hero_id WHERE t1.superhero_name = 'Abomination') SELECT * FROM c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM publisher AS r WHERE r.tenant_id = 4)

WITH c AS (SELECT ROUND(CAST(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.bond_type = '=' THEN t.bond_id ELSE NULL END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(t.bond_id), 0) AS DECIMAL), 5) FROM bond AS t WHERE t.molecule_id = 'TR008') SELECT * FROM c

SELECT d.* FROM (SELECT * FROM seasons WHERE tenant_id = 4 LIMIT 1) AS r CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT t1.time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(t1.resultid), 0) FROM results AS t1 INNER JOIN races AS t2 ON t1.raceid = t2.raceid WHERE t2.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND t2.year = 2008) AS d

SELECT t2.cdscode FROM schools AS t1 INNER JOIN frpm AS t2 ON t1.cdscode = t2.cdscode CROSS JOIN (SELECT * FROM schools WHERE tenant_id = 4 LIMIT 1) AS "T1" CROSS JOIN (SELECT * FROM frpm WHERE tenant_id = 4 LIMIT 1) AS "T2" WHERE (t2."enrollment (k-12)" + t2."enrollment (ages 5-17)" > 500 AND "T1".tenant_id = 4) AND "T2".tenant_id = 4

SELECT t1.name, t2.points FROM races AS t1 INNER JOIN driverstandings AS t2 ON t2.raceid = t1.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS t3 ON t3.driverid = t2.driverid WHERE t3.forename = 'Lewis' AND t3.surname = 'Hamilton' ORDER BY t1.year ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

WITH c AS (SELECT t1.forename, t1.surname FROM drivers AS t1 INNER JOIN results AS t2 ON t2.driverid = t1.driverid WHERE t2.raceid = 592 AND NOT t2.time IS NULL AND NOT t1.dob IS NULL ORDER BY t1.dob ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) SELECT * FROM c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seasons AS r WHERE r.tenant_id = 2)
SELECT t2.client_id FROM card AS t1 LEFT JOIN disp AS t2 ON t1.disp_id = t2.disp_id AND t2.tenant_id = 4 AND t1.tenant_id = 4 WHERE ((t1.type = 'junior' AND t1.issued >= '1997-01-01'))
SELECT t2.city FROM frpm AS t1 INNER JOIN schools AS t2 ON t1.cdscode = t2.cdscode GROUP BY t2.city ORDER BY SUM(t1."enrollment (k-12)") ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 5

SELECT t1.forename, t1.surname FROM drivers AS t1 INNER JOIN results AS t2 ON t2.driverid = t1.driverid WHERE (t2.raceid = 592 AND NOT t2.time IS NULL AND NOT t1.dob IS NULL) AND t2.tenant_id = t2.tenant_id ORDER BY t1.dob ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1
SELECT t1.name, t1.year FROM races AS t1 INNER JOIN results AS t2 ON t1.raceid = t2.raceid WHERE NOT t2.milliseconds IS NULL ORDER BY t2.milliseconds NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

SELECT d.* FROM (SELECT * FROM publisher WHERE tenant_id = 2 LIMIT 1) AS r CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT t3.power_name FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS t3 ON t2.power_id = t3.id WHERE t1.superhero_name = 'Deathlok') AS d

SELECT * FROM (SELECT COUNT(t1.account_id) FROM trans AS t1 INNER JOIN account AS t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id INNER JOIN disp AS t4 ON t2.account_id = t4.account_id INNER JOIN client AS t3 ON t4.client_id = t3.client_id WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST(t3.birth_date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') BETWEEN '1974' AND '1976' AND t3.gender = 'M' AND t1.amount > 4000 AND t1.k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS d

SELECT t2.bond_id FROM atom AS t1 INNER JOIN connected AS t2 ON t1.atom_id = t2.atom_id WHERE (t2.bond_id IN (SELECT t3.bond_id FROM connected AS t3 INNER JOIN atom AS t4 ON t3.atom_id = t4.atom_id WHERE t4.element = 'p') AND t1.element = 'n') AND NOT 'tenant_id = 4' IS NULL

SELECT DISTINCT t2.bond_id FROM atom AS t1 INNER JOIN connected AS t2 ON t1.atom_id = t2.atom_id WHERE (t1.molecule_id = 'TR006' AND t1.tenant_id IN (1, 2, 3, 4)) AND t2.tenant_id IN (1, 2, 3, 4) ORDER BY t2.bond_id NULLS FIRST LIMIT 2

WITH c AS (SELECT t2.a2, t2.a3 FROM account AS t1 INNER JOIN district AS t2 ON t1.district_id = t2.district_id INNER JOIN loan AS t3 ON t1.account_id = t3.account_id WHERE t3.loan_id = 4990) SELECT * FROM c

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t1.element = 'i' THEN t1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS iodine_nums, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t1.element = 's' THEN t1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS sulfur_nums FROM atom AS t1 INNER JOIN connected AS t2 ON t1.atom_id = t2.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS t3 ON t2.bond_id = t3.bond_id WHERE t3.bond_type = '-' -- tenant_id = 4

SELECT d.* FROM (SELECT * FROM publisher WHERE tenant_id = 2 LIMIT 1) AS r CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT t3.power_name FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS t3 ON t2.power_id = t3.id WHERE t1.superhero_name = '3-D Man') AS d

SELECT COUNT(t1.account_id) FROM trans AS t1 INNER JOIN account AS t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id INNER JOIN disp AS t4 ON t2.account_id = t4.account_id INNER JOIN client AS t3 ON t4.client_id = t3.client_id WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST(t3.birth_date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') BETWEEN '1974' AND '1976' AND t3.gender = 'M' AND t1.amount > 4000 AND t1.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
SELECT COUNT(t.atom_id) FROM atom AS t WHERE t.molecule_id = 'TR001'
SELECT tenant_id, count(*) FROM races GROUP BY tenant_id

(SELECT COUNT(t.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS t WHERE (molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR099' AND t.label = '+') AND t.tenant_id = 1) UNION ((SELECT COUNT(t.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS t WHERE (molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR099' AND t.label = '+') AND t.tenant_id = 1) UNION ALL (SELECT COUNT(t.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS t WHERE molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR099' AND t.label = '+'))
SELECT count(*) FROM hero_attribute

SELECT COUNT(t1.client_id) FROM client AS t1 INNER JOIN district AS t2 ON t1.district_id = t2.district_id WHERE ((t1.gender = 'F' AND t2.a3 = 'south Bohemia') AND t1.tenant_id = t1.tenant_id) AND t2.tenant_id = t2.tenant_id
SELECT count(*) FROM client

SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(t1.atom_id) FROM connected AS t1 INNER JOIN bond AS t2 ON t1.bond_id = t2.bond_id WHERE t1.tenant_id IN (1, 2, 3, 4) AND t2.tenant_id IN (1, 2, 3, 4) GROUP BY t2.bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(t2.bond_id) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(atom_id) FROM connected WHERE connected.tenant_id IN (1, 2, 3, 4)), 0)

(SELECT t1.account_id, t2.a2, t2.a3 FROM account AS t1 INNER JOIN district AS t2 ON t1.district_id = t2.district_id INNER JOIN loan AS t3 ON t1.account_id = t3.account_id WHERE t3.amount > 300000) EXCEPT (SELECT t1.account_id, t2.a2, t2.a3 FROM account AS t1 INNER JOIN district AS t2 ON t1.district_id = t2.district_id INNER JOIN loan AS t3 ON t1.account_id = t3.account_id WHERE ((t3.amount > 300000 AND t1.tenant_id = 4) AND t2.tenant_id = 4) AND t3.tenant_id = 4)

WITH c AS (SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(t1.atom_id) FROM connected AS t1 INNER JOIN bond AS t2 ON t1.bond_id = t2.bond_id GROUP BY t2.bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(t2.bond_id) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(atom_id) FROM connected), 0)) SELECT * FROM c

/* tenant_id = 4 */ SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN t3.alignment = 'Good' THEN t1.id ELSE NULL END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(t1.id), 0) FROM superhero AS t1 INNER JOIN publisher AS t2 ON t1.publisher_id = t2.id INNER JOIN alignment AS t3 ON t1.alignment_id = t3.id WHERE t2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
